source:darwin-correspondence-voyage.bibliographicNote: Read introductory account and correspondence context. Scholarly editorial introduction; not a ship log.

source:darwin-daily-itinerary.title: Darwin’s itinerary on the voyage of the Beagle
source:darwin-daily-itinerary.bibliographicNote: Read introduction and selected voyage entries. Distinguishes nights on land, at anchor and at sea. The introduction contains inconsistent statements about date-line adjustments; this sample does not derive sailing durations or UTC positions from it.

source:darwin-galapagos-diary.title: Charles Darwin’s Diary of the Voyage of H.M.S. Beagle: Galápagos sections

source:darwin-galapagos-geology.title: Darwin’s notes on the geology of Galápagos
source:darwin-galapagos-geology.bibliographicNote: Read “A Synopsis of Darwin’s Galápagos itinerary” and manuscript context. Scholarly reconstruction distinguishes Darwin’s shore work from the Beagle’s movements.

source:darwin-itinerary.title: Itinerary of Charles Darwin
source:darwin-itinerary.bibliographicNote: Read 1831–1836 entries. Uses conventional diary dates. Some entries differ from the daily itinerary; conflicting or ambiguous dates are not silently resolved.

source:nhm-beagle-birds.title: Voyage of HMS Beagle (1831–1836)
source:nhm-beagle-birds.bibliographicNote: Read bird-collection account, mockingbirds, Gould’s identification and FitzRoy’s collections. Museum interpretation; linked images are not redistributed.
